import sqlite3

# Symbolic constants for availability status
BOOK_AVAILABLE = 1
BOOK_UNAVAILABLE = 0

# Table name constant
BOOKS_TABLE_NAME = "books"


class BookManagementDB:
    def __init__(self, db_name):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(db_name)
        self.cursor = self.connection.cursor()
        self._create_table()

    def _create_table(self):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME} (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT,
                author TEXT,
                available INTEGER
            )
        ''')
        self._commit()

    def _commit(self):
        self.connection.commit()

    def add_book(self, title, author):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            INSERT INTO {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME} (title, author, available)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ''', (title, author, BOOK_AVAILABLE))
        self._commit()

    def remove_book(self, book_id):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            DELETE FROM {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME} WHERE id = ?
        ''', (book_id,))
        self._commit()

    def borrow_book(self, book_id):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            UPDATE {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME} SET available = ? WHERE id = ?
        ''', (BOOK_UNAVAILABLE, book_id))
        self._commit()

    def return_book(self, book_id):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            UPDATE {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME} SET available = ? WHERE id = ?
        ''', (BOOK_AVAILABLE, book_id))
        self._commit()

    def search_books(self):
        self.cursor.execute(f'''
            SELECT * FROM {BOOKS_TABLE_NAME}
        ''')
        books = self.cursor.fetchall()
        return books
